purpose: JCAMP-DX importer compatibility research and validation policy

findings.name: readJDX (Bryan Hanson)
findings.note: Documents compressed ASDF decoding; the R package is a candidate for offline conversion/validation, not a browser dependency.

findings.name: JSpecView
findings.note: Published capabilities include JCAMP-DX loading, spectral inspection and export; evaluate as a separate conversion/validation tool.

findings.name: IUPAC JCAMP-DX standard
findings.note: Defines compressed numeric encodings; format documentation is not an experimental spectral source.

integration_decision: No spectra added in this round. Do not label a conversion tool as a source of experimental measurements. A compressed-file decoder must be tested against reference fixtures and NPOINTS/FIRSTX/LASTX/DELTAX and scaling factors before production use.
